API Guide and Sample Code

This file contains documentation for the Falcon SDK and Sample Code.

The goal of this document is to provide developers a quick index of all the functions, their parameters and all the constant definitions. It also provides a set of examples that detail how to use many of the Falcon System components and Open Source Software Packages in the SDK.
